brief.text: Borr Drilling (BORR) recorded the largest cluster total at $32.06 million across three insiders, while Bluerock Private Real Estate Fund (BPRE) followed with $21.52 million, boosted by director Ramin Kamfar's $8.50 million purchase. Dick'S Sporting Goods (DKS) stood out for breadth of participation, drawing an unusual group of seven individual insiders who combined for $5.59 million. Among single-entity transactions, Nippon Life Insurance’s $20.88 million stake in CRBG was by far the largest, while Saba Capital Management accumulated stakes across multiple closed-end funds including GRX and ECF.
